source_revisions.note: Both consumers use the same pushed framework revision and geometry source hash.

inverse_3x3.contract: Finite 3x3 input; parameterized determinant and coefficient limits; complete inverse published only on success.

conservative_box_visibility.contract: Eight corners through model and eye transforms; reject only when all corners are outside one plane; unknown or saturated input maps to the caller's conservative keep policy.

slab_ray_box.contract: Positive/negative/parallel rays, clamped range and entry distance; null, non-finite, reversed range or reversed bounds rejected without output writes.

retained_title_differences: Reference inverse rejects determinant magnitudes above 64 and coefficients above 8.
Underground inverse has no upper determinant bound and accepts coefficients through 64.
Underground MP visibility retains center/radius expansion, overflow rejection, view validation, P1 ownership and native fallback.
Title tree layouts, masks, traversal limits, hooks, projection parameters and weapon behavior remain local.
Laser projection/clipping remains deferred; input mapping and W1/W2 weapon hooks were not moved or rewritten.

covered: singular, near-singular, threshold, high-determinant, coefficient and non-finite inverse policies
forward, behind, side and plane-crossing boxes
Q12 and precise view paths, eye rotation/translation, asymmetric projection and 512x240/540x120 bounds
positive, negative and parallel slab rays, range clamping, reversed inputs and malformed values
